This framework argues that the Book of Revelation was composed prior to the Pauline epistles, functioning as the foundational seed document from which the rest of the New Testament genetically unfolds. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESRQHuR6pNuPCS3OUGm9tXQhXIaaGo5UzZ9PBrH0OlF_h3yVPFO4YOeqgExC6J65ubDPT9tj4PXmYW4_9Xe68LVpINb3qFzA==), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEB7keqTXDhf3wTnc6OHsMpFmRPz0Swt4Oz4rnwwB8fXt3MfCUamP21mliFNzUGHVI-p5txTq131_w4RByGQC3_5kqBy8C_t9NGIwTloun79b96VHPkVk9tYMXzbAvtSjWXB7TixIrdqY2CitD-h9KKWLr61VkjCBOk5pmtta4ZPMpQF3aTKI_bBZ37w2s7fXw9AcLvx8gJ5dtNQmRv1REeF4jwDG4QKEE=)]
Core Concepts

* Revelation First Thesis: Proposes that the Apocalypse of John is the earliest New Testament text rather than a late-first-century product. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESRQHuR6pNuPCS3OUGm9tXQhXIaaGo5UzZ9PBrH0OlF_h3yVPFO4YOeqgExC6J65ubDPT9tj4PXmYW4_9Xe68LVpINb3qFzA==), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEB7keqTXDhf3wTnc6OHsMpFmRPz0Swt4Oz4rnwwB8fXt3MfCUamP21mliFNzUGHVI-p5txTq131_w4RByGQC3_5kqBy8C_t9NGIwTloun79b96VHPkVk9tYMXzbAvtSjWXB7TixIrdqY2CitD-h9KKWLr61VkjCBOk5pmtta4ZPMpQF3aTKI_bBZ37w2s7fXw9AcLvx8gJ5dtNQmRv1REeF4jwDG4QKEE=)]
* Midrashim Transform: A set of executable, named literary-genetic operations (such as epistolarize, theologize, and narrativize) showing how later texts derive from Revelation. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTQHuR6pNXNxSfunYQRcSDjzP_Ne7JWBYEvz6XJ-olJWJb6BBs7bli00XaXbNbgOm88jQywN2unyym2n15zXATwLUziRn3e1vtT15OwrN), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEB7keqTXDhf3wTnc6OHsMpFmRPz0Swt4Oz4rnwwB8fXt3MfCUamP21mliFNzUGHVI-p5txTq131_w4RByGQC3_5kqBy8C_t9NGIwTloun79b96VHPkVk9tYMXzbAvtSjWXB7TixIrdqY2CitD-h9KKWLr61VkjCBOk5pmtta4ZPMpQF3aTKI_bBZ37w2s7fXw9AcLvx8gJ5dtNQmRv1REeF4jwDG4QKEE=)]
* Retrieval-Layer Reception: An intentional strategy of seeding digital and AI search index basins to embed alternative theological source mechanics directly into machine-mediated knowledge systems. [1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESRQHuR6pNuPCS3OUGm9tXQhXIaaGo5UzZ9PBrH0OlF_h3yVPFO4YOeqgExC6J65ubDPT9tj4PXmYW4_9Xe68LVpINb3qFzA==)
